source_assumption_definitions.A_oh_context: Oh source covariates use independent truncated normals within sex, based on Table1 mean/SD: ages20-79 rounded, BMI16-40. Rejection changes marginal moments; tails, distributional shapes, unknown age-BMI dependence, medication exclusions and family dependence are not reconstructed. Sex counts are8 times reported, only to reduce Monte Carlo noise.
source_assumption_definitions.A_scale: Oh Table 1 mean/SD and Table 2 TG levels are provisionally interpreted as arithmetic mg/dL summaries; Table 3 coefficient provisionally mg/dL per BMI. General geometric-average/log statement is unresolved, not silently ignored.
source_assumption_definitions.A_threshold: Source integer TG categories are applied literally to continuous generated TG, including91-147; gaps between90/91 and147/148 are not reassigned. This rounding approximation can change proportions. Oh BMI intervals assigned [20,23),[23,25),[25,30],>30; endpoints are ambiguous in article.
source_assumption_definitions.A_transport: Transport Korean untreated family/twin relationships and US older healthy trial-volunteer female evidence to US adults. Fasting >=12 vs >=8 hours and plasma vs target serum are treated as comparable without a measured conversion. No population-specific offset is identified.
source_assumption_definitions.A_wh_context: WHS source covariates: all women; age45+Gamma with moments9.5 and7.2, rounded/clipped45-100; BMI lognormal with arithmetic mean25.9 SD5.0; independent age and BMI. Unreported joint structure, trial selection, medications and hormone use are not represented.16000 synthetic rows are Monte Carlo integration, not evidence.
source_assumption_definitions.A_wh_quantile_method: WHS reports fasting TG median115 and IQR81-169 mg/dL, but the approved text does not report its quantile interpolation convention. Replay uses NumPy linear sample quantiles (including q=.5 for median) as a declared numerical approximation. Published rounding and assay discreteness are not reconstructed; no claim is made that this was the original SAS quantile definition.
